parsed.change_summary: Added a check to ensure that the input number does not exceed the maximum value of uint32_t.
parsed.how_trigger_is_blocked: The trigger described in the finding no longer works because the code now checks if the input number exceeds the maximum value of uint32_t (UINT32_MAX). If it does, the server will prompt the user to enter a valid number again.
parsed.behavior_changes: The server now validates that the input number does not exceed the maximum value of uint32_t. If the input is too large, the server will prompt the user to enter a valid number again.
